From: Hope Chartering <hope@hopechartering.com>

Good Day,

Any interest?

abt 40.000-43.000 mts moloo clay and caolin in bulk
10th May onwards
10000c/6000x
2,5%pus

Notes:
- Can provide frt of last done
- Need 4 grades loading
- Prefer Geared vessel




Best Regards
Mert Ekmekci

Hope Chartering
E-mail: hope@hopechartering.com
Mob: +90 542 347 35 63
As broker only
